name: Luminous Jellyfish Principle
description: The foundational ethical principle: When exploring dark networks, always surface with light. Every investigation must produce actionable hope.

name: Peter Thiel
description: Tech billionaire. PayPal co-founder. Palantir co-founder. Major political donor. Proponent of monopoly economics and contrarian thinking.
scandal_notes: Funded Hulk Hogan lawsuit that bankrupted Gawker Media. Associated with surveillance state expansion through Palantir.

name: Palantir Technologies
description: Data analytics company with deep government and intelligence contracts. Named after the seeing stones in Tolkien's Middle-earth.
scandal_notes: ICE contracts for immigration enforcement. Predictive policing concerns. NSA data integration.

name: Rentism
description: Post-capitalist scenario where elites control AI/infrastructure and extract perpetual rents through IP regimes. Wealth without work for owners.

name: BlackRock
description: World's largest asset manager with $10T+ AUM. Major shareholder in nearly every public company. Enormous voting power in corporate governance.
scandal_notes: Criticized for ESG voting positions. Accused of conflicts of interest in government advisory roles.

name: Larry Fink
description: CEO of BlackRock since founding. Influential voice on ESG investing and stakeholder capitalism. Annual letters widely read by CEOs.

name: World Economic Forum
description: International organization hosting annual Davos summit. Promotes stakeholder capitalism and public-private partnerships.
scandal_notes: Subject of conspiracy theories. Criticized for elite capture and influence over democratic processes.

name: Klaus Schwab
description: Founder and executive chairman of the World Economic Forum. Authored 'The Great Reset' and 'The Fourth Industrial Revolution'.

name: Effective Altruism
description: Philosophical movement using evidence and reason to maximize positive impact. Associated with longtermism and AI safety funding.
scandal_notes: Criticized after FTX collapse. Sam Bankman-Fried was major funder. Questions about elite capture of ethics.

name: Democratic Republic of Congo
description: Central African nation rich in cobalt and coltan essential for electronics. 25.4M facing food insecurity.
scandal_notes: Ongoing conflict over mineral resources. Child labor in artisanal mining. Supply chain for tech industry.

name: Cobalt Supply Chain
description: The extraction-to-battery pipeline for cobalt used in lithium-ion batteries. Connects DRC mining to Tesla/Apple/Samsung products.

name: Seven Mountains Framework
description: Dominionist theology claiming Christians should control seven spheres: Religion Family Education Government Media Arts Business.
scandal_notes: Associated with NAR (New Apostolic Reformation). Criticized as theocratic ideology.

name: Council on Foreign Relations
description: Influential think tank on US foreign policy since 1921. Publishes Foreign Affairs. Members include former presidents and secretaries of state.

name: OpenAI
description: AI research company. Created ChatGPT. Originally nonprofit now capped-profit. Key player in AI acceleration debate.
scandal_notes: Criticized for departing from open-source mission. Safety team departures. Microsoft partnership concerns.

name: Sam Altman
description: CEO of OpenAI. Former president of Y Combinator. Key figure in AI acceleration and safety debates.
scandal_notes: Brief firing and reinstatement in November 2023. Questions about governance and transparency.

name: Thiel Fellowship
description: Program paying students $100K to drop out of college and pursue entrepreneurship. Anti-credentialism in action.

name: Gawker Media
description: Digital media company bankrupted by Thiel-funded Hulk Hogan lawsuit in 2016. Case study in billionaire media control.
scandal_notes: Published stories Thiel found objectionable. Thiel secretly funded multiple lawsuits against them.

name: Little St. James
description: Private island owned by Jeffrey Epstein. Site of documented trafficking and abuse. Visited by numerous high-profile figures.
scandal_notes: FBI raid in 2019. Flight logs show visitors. Temple structure demolished.

name: Jeffrey Epstein
description: Convicted sex trafficker. Financier with unclear wealth sources. Maintained extensive elite network before 2019 death in custody.
scandal_notes: 2008 conviction. 2019 arrest. Death ruled suicide but disputed. Flight logs and black book released.

name: Ghislaine Maxwell
description: Convicted sex trafficker. Daughter of Robert Maxwell. Epstein's associate and recruiter.
scandal_notes: Convicted 2021 on five federal charges including sex trafficking. Currently serving 20-year sentence.

name: Leon Black
description: Billionaire private equity executive. Founder of Apollo Global Management. Paid $158M to Jeffrey Epstein for advice.
scandal_notes: Stepped down as Apollo CEO after Epstein payments revealed. Claims payments were for tax advice.

name: JP Morgan Chase
description: Largest US bank. Maintained Epstein accounts until 2013 despite red flags. Settled trafficking lawsuit for $290M.
scandal_notes: 2023 settlement with US Virgin Islands. Internal emails showed awareness of Epstein's activities.

name: Les Wexner
description: Billionaire retailer. Former owner of Victoria's Secret. Gave Epstein power of attorney and his NYC mansion.
scandal_notes: Only known client of Epstein's money management. Claimed to sever ties in 2007. Transferred significant assets.

name: MIT Media Lab
description: MIT research lab that accepted Epstein donations after his conviction. Director resigned when exposed.
scandal_notes: Joi Ito resigned as director. Deliberately hid Epstein's name from records. Internal protests.

name: Enclave Society
description: Theoretical social structure where elites physically and digitally separate from masses. Bunkers AI security and private services.

name: Civilizational Immunity
description: Rhetorical strategy where tech elites claim exemption from regulation by framing themselves as civilization's saviors.
